plainTranslation: A's love and values meets B's identity. The conjunction fuses them - intense and inseparable.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.

summaryShort: Their affection, preferences, and wish to keep things pleasant sit right on top of your sense of self, confidence, and direction.
summaryDeep: Their affection, preferences, and wish to keep things pleasant sit right on top of your sense of self, confidence, and direction. This is one of the closest contacts between you, strong and constant, energizing at its best and a lot to hold at its worst. Let the closeness feed you without letting it run you.
tension: The thing to watch is that pleasant can stay shallow. If everything stays nice and nobody ever pushes past the easy surface, the connection can stall at "we get along great" without becoming much deeper.
advice: Let yourself enjoy it, but don't stop at nice. Liking someone is a good start, not the whole story.
